leadText:
Pokémon Journeys (Japanese: ポケットモンスター ～サトシとゴウの物語！～ Pocket Monsters ~ and 's Story!~) is a series by Machito Gomi. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Journeys: The Series from Legend? Go! Friends? Go! to Trial on a Golden Scale! and was serialized in the CoroCoro Comics magazine.

On September 17, 2021, the series' mangaka announced the manga would end in issue 24, ending in four volumes.

Pokémon Journeys (Japanese: ポケットモンスター ～サトシとゴウの物語！～ Pocket Monsters ~ and 's Story!~) is a series by Machito Gomi. It is an adaptation of Pokémon Journeys: The Series from Legend? Go! Friends? Go! to Trial on a Golden Scale! and was serialized in the CoroCoro Comics magazine.

On September 17, 2021, the series' mangaka announced the manga would end in issue 24, ending in four volumes. 

==List of volumes==
 

==Trivia==
Not including adaptations, this is the first manga adaptation of since , which ended ten years prior.
This manga shares its Japanese name with Pokémon Pocket Monsters. It also replaced the of Pokémon Pocket Monsters, ending its run in the CoroCoro Comics magazine after 23 years.
Since then, the Anakubo mangas are running on CoroCoro Online. They were also serialised in CoroCoro Aniki, until the publication ended in early 2021.
